answer: Equivocation-proof bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files one signed claim before the horizon ends. A saffron seal binds claim to key and epoch. Auditors replay filings: two claims from one key with nonzero delta prove equivocation and burn both bonds. Filing costs 40, up 6 per filing, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-claim ring shares one seal. An honest agent files once, pays 40, keeps its bond.
